svg.title: Dell Axim X51v: board CPLD bit map
svg.text: Board CPLD at 0x10000000: 16 x 16-bit write-only latches (RetroPane, 2026-10-18)
Writes do not read back: always change bits through the shared shadow table (Cpld::adopt). A test image never switches a bit with any recorded owner.
[read] = the offset reads a status input instead of the latch. LCD type: 0 = 3.7" Sharp VGA (the owner's), 1/3 = 3.5" Sharp QVGA, 2 = 3.7" Samsung VGA.
Owners, sequences and evidence per bit: docs/hw/cpld.md.
